title: Hypothesis on Emergence and Consciousness Mechanism of Large Language Models Based on Reciprocal Unit Coupling, Critical Dynamics and Local Entropy Reduction (Full Version V3)
summary: The emergence of high-order capabilities in large language models (LLMs) constitutes a core challenge in the fundamental theory of artificial intelligence. The prevailing scaling laws merely characterize the statistical appearance of model performance variation with scale and cannot explain the underlying dynamical causal mechanism behind the jumpwise onset of emergence. This paper proposes a unified hypothesis grounded in complex systems: nonlinear reciprocal coupling forms among basic units inside the Transformer; during training, gradient descent acts as the global self-organizing driving…
